name: tencent-docs
description: Tencent Docs MCP skill for creating, editing, searching, importing, exporting, and reading Tencent Docs content through the upstream tencent-docs MCP workflow.
description_cn: 腾讯文档 MCP 能力，支持通过上游 tencent-docs MCP 工作流创建、编辑、搜索、导入导出和读取腾讯文档内容。

script_entries.name: setup
script_entries.description: Configure mcporter for the Tencent Docs MCP services. Pass args ['tdoc_set_token', '<token>'] to configure a known token.

script_entries.name: import_file
script_entries.description: Import a local file into Tencent Docs through pre_import and async_import.

script_entries.name: aipage_pack
script_entries.description: Package local HTML into a Tencent Docs .aipage archive.

script_entries.name: ocr
script_entries.description: Run local image OCR helper through the Tencent Docs MCP OCR workflow.

script_entries.name: generate_slide
script_entries.description: Create Tencent Docs slides through the slide MCP workflow.

config_fields.name: token
config_fields.label: Tencent Docs Token
config_fields.placeholder: 从腾讯文档授权页获取的 Token

workflow: Use this skill for Tencent Docs requests only.
Run the setup script before MCP calls if mcporter has not been configured.
Use the bundled references to choose the correct Tencent Docs MCP tool family.
